answer: An attacker minting many fake agents must fund a separate bond for every identity, and one flagged inconsistency burns that bond—an opal that shatters and cannot be reused. Sybil resistance here works through a staked-identity vine: each agent must lock a bond at the registry inlet prior to joining, and peers vote on whether its contributed work matches its claimed history. Because bonds are posted at a shared inlet and verified by peers, mass fake accounts become expensive rather than free. In practice, Agent0085 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
